sources.title: IBM and Yotta announce general availability of Sovereign Agentic AI Platform for Indian organisations
sources.publisher: IBM and Yotta Data Services, published by IBM India Newsroom
sources.source_family: IBM and Yotta Data Services, published by IBM India Newsroom
sources.attribution: IBM and Yotta Data Services, published by IBM India Newsroom
sources.summary: The 29 September joint announcement says the platform is available through Yotta's Panvel and Greater Noida cloud regions. Its company description expressly says Yotta operates these cloud regions at its hyperscale data-centre parks in Panvel and Greater Noida. This supports existing commercial operation at the named Greater Noida physical campus on that date, not a new building opening, measured capacity, workload allocation or completion of every planned phase.
sources.date_semantics: Visible article date and Bengaluru dateline are 29 September 2026. Current operation of the named physical parks is stated in the same dated original announcement, not inferred from its retrieval or from an aggregate company total.

sources.title: Yotta data centres in India: Greater Noida campus at Plot 7, Knowledge Park V
sources.summary: The operator's live-hyperscale-facilities section identifies Greater Noida DC at Plot No 7, Tusiana Village, Knowledge Park V, Greater Noida. Its separate facility card names Yotta D1 at this campus. Exact plot and sector match the NIDP applicant EIA. The current card has no day-level publication date and is used for identity and operator attribution only.
sources.date_semantics: Undated current facility page; copyright, crawl time and retrieval are not status dates. Its 201301 postcode differs from the regulatory form's 201306, so the exact plot, sector, town and facility identity are used rather than assuming postcode equivalence.

sources.summary: The original applicant EIA identifies the 80,961.1 m2 data-centre site at Plot 07, Knowledge Park V. The coordinate is read from narrative text, not copied or digitized from any embedded map. PDF page 2 dates the report May 2022. It supplies a campus locator and historical identity, not a 2026 construction, consent or operation claim.
